class Student:

        return True

    def getNumber(self):
        return self._number

    def getMentor(self, index):
        return self._mentors[index]

    def getMentors(self):
        return tuple(self._mentors)

    def numberOfMentors(self):
        return len(self._mentors)

    def hasMentors(self):
        return len(self._mentors) > 0

    def indexOfMentor(self, aMentor):
        return next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._mentors) if x is aMentor), -1)

    @staticmethod
    def minimumNumberOfMentors():
        return 5

    @staticmethod
    def maximumNumberOfMentors():
        return 5

    def addMentor(self, aMentor):
        if any(x is aMentor for x in self._mentors):
            return False
        if self.numberOfMentors() >= __class__.maximumNumberOfMentors():
            return False
        self._mentors.append(aMentor)
        if aMentor.indexOfStudent(self) == -1 and not aMentor.addStudent(self):
            del self._mentors[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._mentors) if x is aMentor), -1)]
            return False
        return True

    def removeMentor(self, aMentor):
        oldIndex = next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._mentors) if x is aMentor), -1)
        if oldIndex == -1:
            return False
        if self.numberOfMentors() <= __class__.minimumNumberOfMentors():
            return False
        del self._mentors[oldIndex]
        if aMentor.indexOfStudent(self) != -1 and not aMentor.removeStudent(self):
            self._mentors.insert(oldIndex, aMentor)
            return False
        return True

    def delete(self):
        copyOfMentors = tuple(self._mentors)
        self._mentors.clear()
        for aMentor in copyOfMentors:
            aMentor.removeStudent(self)

                + "number:" + str(self.getNumber())
                + "]")
